summary: All four fleet-batch review fixes landed: busy pinned ports now name the conflicting pool and pid from the fleet registry (best-effort, fallback kept), the pool lock claims atomically via O_EXCL with conditional failed-bind cleanup closing the TOCTOU window, fleet registry writes serialize through a liveness-checked lockfile plus temp-and-rename, and the em dash in server.ts prose is gone. Verified with live two-pool tests and real concurrent process launches; 220 tests, typecheck, and UI build clean.
